description: Read-only SPARQL 1.1 query endpoint for the etzhayyim Knowledge Graph (ADR-2605190900 stage K2.b). Served by the kg-appview ephemeral in-memory store rebuilt from MST + IPFS on cold start; never mutates substrate. SPARQL UPDATE keywords (INSERT / DELETE / LOAD / CLEAR / CREATE / DROP / COPY / MOVE / ADD) are rejected with HTTP 403. Response encoding depends on the SPARQL form: SELECT and ASK default to application/sparql-results+json (override with format=xml or format=csv); CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE default to text/turtle (override with format=ntriples or format=rdfxml).

query.description: SPARQL 1.1 query string. Must be SELECT / ASK / CONSTRUCT / DESCRIBE. UPDATE forms are rejected.

format.description: Optional response-format override. Use 'json' / 'xml' / 'csv' for SELECT/ASK; 'turtle' / 'ntriples' / 'rdfxml' for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. If omitted, Accept-header negotiation falls back to the format defaults documented at the lexicon level.

output.description: SPARQL Query Results JSON for SELECT/ASK, or text/turtle (or the format requested via the format parameter) for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. The HTTP Content-Type header carries the actual encoding chosen by the server.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.description: The provided SPARQL string failed to parse or evaluate. The server returns the parser/evaluator message in the response body.

errors.name: UpdateNotAllowed
errors.description: The provided SPARQL contained an UPDATE keyword. This endpoint is read-only by design (ADR-2605190900 K2 kotoba guarantee).
